question: does same-root counterfactual supervision close the generated-state gap?

design.parent: Raw-10k (paired/raw/step-010000.pt), encoder FROZEN, world continued 10k updates
design.Ap_data: factual + fork roots' FACTUAL transition, 68 INDEPENDENT roots/update
design.B_sibling: factual + all 17 SAME-ROOT successors, 4 roots x 17 = 68 targets/update
design.budget: A' and B receive an IDENTICAL number of extra gradient targets (68/update); they differ only in whether those targets are independent roots or siblings of one root
design.pinned: same frozen encoder and pre-encoded latents, same init, optimizer, LR, schedule, updates, RNG, factual batches, MSE, context, and a root+action control computed from the frozen encoder so it is identical across arms
design.batchnorm: predictor-projector BN running stats frozen in ALL arms, so branch batches cannot move them in A'/B but not A

VERDICT: NULL, and trending negative. No arm beats its own root+action control on either panel, and none approaches the predeclared +10 point threshold.
findings: B (sibling counterfactual supervision) does NOT help: 48.67/100 against a 55.67 control, paired -0.08 [-0.168, +0.010]. The interval does not exclude zero but the point estimate is negative.
A' (the same data volume, factual only) also does not help: 50.0/100.
Ordering is A_control 53.0 > A'_data 50.0 > B_sibling 48.67. Adding the fork corpus slightly hurt; adding sibling structure hurt slightly more.
Factual held-out MSE is flat across arms (0.01565 / 0.01546 / 0.01570), so nothing was traded away to buy the null -- the arms did not abandon the factual objective.
Both A' and B fit their EXTRA targets to the same degree (final extra loss 0.0130 vs 0.0129), so the null is not one arm failing to learn its targets.

ACTION SENSITIVITY WENT DOWN, not up: frozen-head derangement AUC cost fell 0.161 (A) -> 0.147 (A') -> 0.114 (B). Training explicitly on 17 branches made the generated states LESS action-discriminative.

mechanism_suggested_not_established.hypothesis: averaging MSE over 17 branch targets rewards predicting their centroid, which contracts the branches and reduces discriminability
mechanism_suggested_not_established.assessment: directionally consistent but MODEST -- spread contracted ~7% while the action-AUC cost fell ~29%. Suggestive, not established. Do not report this as the mechanism.

what_this_rules_out: 'just add counterfactual data and supervise it with MSE' is NOT the fix. Both the data (A') and the sibling structure (B) were tested at matched budget and neither helped.
what_it_points_at: the LOSS FORM rather than the data or the supervision structure. An action-centred / delta / contrastive objective is the next candidate -- which is exactly the fallback anticipated before this ran.
TC_not_run: the instruction was to extend to TC only if Raw came back positive. It did not, so TC was not run. TC also still carries its independent CLS->z export defect, which this treatment does not address.
limits: one model seed per arm (three probe seeds)
10k continuation updates from Raw-10k, not a fresh joint retrain
one point in the hyperparameter space: mass 0.2, 4 fork roots/update
frozen encoder throughout; a jointly adapted encoder may behave differently
intervals are wide -- 'null' means no detectable improvement, NOT proven equivalence
